pressures.broad_arrow: many related coordinates + reusable regularity -> reusable parameterized transformations
pressures.registered_evidence: 3-site repeated local rule has equal behavior with one shared description vs three copies
pressures.nearest_counterexample: site-specific unrelated rules where a single shared transform cannot represent all sites

pressures.broad_arrow: high-dimensional structured mapping + finite description budget -> factorized/compositional representation over a table
pressures.registered_evidence: n-bit parity can be composed from n-1 reusable binary XOR process blocks while a literal total table has 2^n rows
pressures.nearest_counterexample: arbitrary unstructured finite map or tiny domain where a table can be cheaper

pressures.broad_arrow: nonlinear target relation -> affine-only capability ceiling
pressures.registered_evidence: for affine f on {0,1}^2, f00+f11=f01+f10; XOR violates 0+0=1+1
pressures.nearest_counterexample: identity target x0 is affine and needs no nonlinear transform

pressures.broad_arrow: repeated low-arity compositional structure -> repeated local transforms/depth pressure
pressures.registered_evidence: parity chain composes the same binary block repeatedly

pressures.broad_arrow: differentiable composite program + scalar loss -> reverse derivative propagation candidate
pressures.registered_evidence: generic reverse accumulation equals exact finite differences away from kinks in frozen graph
pressures.nearest_counterexample: discrete/nondifferentiable process with no registered derivative semantics

pressures.registered_evidence: shared NOT rule has identical semantics with one description vs three copied descriptions

pressures.broad_arrow: temporal partial observability -> persistent/recurrent state pressure
pressures.registered_evidence: same current input with different required delayed output makes stateless policy impossible; one bit solves

pressures.broad_arrow: variable context-dependent relevance -> dynamic routing pressure
pressures.registered_evidence: query selects one of two values; fixed-index routes fail some cases, query-conditioned selection solves all
pressures.nearest_counterexample: relevance fixed to one source in every context

combination_rule: Do not infer a whole architecture from one pressure; combine only after independent pressure evidence under a common ecology/resource frame.
